description: SERVER side. Build the HTTP 402 price an agent-paid resource returns, settled privately through Gloam: the amount and parties never go public. Returns it in both dialects: x402 requirements (and their encoded form), and an MPP challenge (mpp.wwwAuthenticate, the WWW-Authenticate: Payment value for method gloam, intent charge). payTo defaults to this server's own receive tag. Check what the payer presents with gloam_verify_payment.

amount.description: Price in the asset's display units, e.g. 0.25.

asset.description: Settlement token address; omit for the network default (USDG on Robinhood Chain mainnet, USDC.e on Tempo mainnet, USDC on Base and Ethereum, PathUSD on Tempo testnet, ETH on Robinhood Chain testnet).

assetSymbol.description: Asset label, e.g. USDC.e; omit for the asset's own symbol.

decimals.description: Decimals of the settlement asset; omit for the asset's own (6 for the stablecoins).

expiresInSeconds.description: How long the MPP challenge stays valid. Leave room to prove and confirm a payment.

network.description: Which Gloam network the payer settles on: "robinhood-mainnet", "tempo-mainnet", "base-mainnet", "ethereum-mainnet", "robinhood", "tempo", "base", "ethereum". The -mainnet ones are the mainnets (beta deposit limits); "robinhood", "tempo", "base" and "ethereum" are the testnets. Default here: "robinhood".

payTo.description: Payee receive tag (gloamr1.…). Omit to be paid to this server's own tag, which gloam_verify_payment can open.

realm.description: MPP protection space for the challenge. Default: the resource URL's host.

resource.description: What is being paid for: a URL or an MCP tool id.

name: gloam_payment_requirements
title: Price a resource in private payments (x402 and MPP)
